text: Added this changelog, so it's easy to see what's new.
Improved how the site shows up on Google and AI assistants, with the right title, description and prices for each page.
Redesigned the pages visitors see when the site is paused or briefly down, so they get a clear, on-brand message with useful links.
Dashboard: photos can now be cropped and repositioned right in the editor, whatever their shape.
Dashboard: testimonials now sit with Results, so each client story and its quote are edited together.
Dashboard: tidied up after the first review. It has a tighter layout, simpler wording, a live preview that follows your edits, and layouts that work on tablets and phones.
Dashboard: new Settings page. It controls the under-construction page, contact email and social links, where enquiries are sent, and how each page looks in Google. Changes apply straight away.
Dashboard: services, prices, booking links and FAQs can now be edited, and FAQs can be added and reordered.
Dashboard: every photo and video spot on the site can be swapped from the Pages section, with a preview of the page before it goes live.
Dashboard: new Media library. You upload photos and videos from a phone or computer, they're resized automatically, and you can see where each one is used.
Dashboard: Results can be added, edited, reordered, hidden and published. Edits save as drafts and nothing goes live until you publish.
Dashboard: Home now shows visits, the most viewed pages and where visitors came from, counted without cookies.
Dashboard: signing in uses a 6-digit code sent to your email, so there's no password to remember.
Fixed result cards on the About and Contact pages not opening when clicked, and the Find Your Fit close button sitting in the wrong spot.
Booking cards on service pages are simpler, and prices are no longer repeated.
Fixed a round of small issues from a full site check: content overflowing on phones, a logo missing on some pages, hard-to-spot links, and settings that stopped Google reading the site properly.
Competition Prep applications now go through Jake's application form, so only applicants take a spot in his calendar.
Service pages got a cleaner two-tone look and tidier pricing sections.
Pricing on each service page now fits neatly on phones and tablets.
Personal Training now shows venue details and session options.
Added a "pause the site" option that shows an under-construction page, so the site can stay hidden until launch.
Fixed the Instagram links and a clipping problem in the related-services carousel.
Fixed enquiry emails not arriving. Messages from the contact form now reach Jake reliably.
Added Find Your Fit, a short questionnaire that helps visitors pick the right coaching option before booking.
Redesigned the Contact page, with a video reel and a scrolling strip of social photos.
Added a Results library where visitors can browse client transformations and open each story in a full-screen viewer.
Redesigned the Services pages with glass-style cards and a services menu in the navigation.
Redesigned the About page, with a carousel of Jake's coaching process and the federation logos.
Added branded "page not found" and "something went wrong" pages, so visitors never see a bare browser error.
New Home page, with a background video behind the headline and an interactive Apple Watch showcase.
The Team JD website rebuild began.
